WorldObjectDef.label: exorcism assignment
WorldObjectDef.description: A school assignment at a haunted settlement. Travel here by caravan, complete the objective and return to the commissioning colony before the deadline.

SitePartDef.label: haunted settlement
SitePartDef.description: Cursed spirits haunt the ruined dwellings. Bring sorcerers, supplies and a way to protect against curses. Retreating does not reset this encounter.

ThingDef.label: sealed cursed object
ThingDef.description: A dangerous cursed object sealed for transport. Return this specific object to the commissioning colony and claim the school contract to hand it over. It cannot be used to learn a technique.

ThingDef.label: sealed refuge
ThingDef.description: A protective refuge around a stranded sorcerer. Clear the assignment's cursed spirits, then release the survivor through Jujutsu headquarters or open this refuge. The survivor will join your colony; bring them home alive.
